title: Tempora-Fusion: Time-Lock Puzzle with Efficient Verifiable Homomorphic Linear Combination
abstract: arXiv:2406.15070v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Tempora-Fusion, the first homomorphic TLP scheme with efficient public verification of both individual puzzle solutions and homomorphic linear combinations. Tempora-Fusion lets clients generate puzzles independently, later authorize a linear combination with its own release time, and enables any party to verify the released result without trusted setup or costly asymmetric-key proof systems. Technically, our construction maps independently generated RSA-based puzzles into a common finite field, uses oblivious linear evaluation to refresh blinding factors during evaluation, and embeds a hidden verification structure by encoding messages as polynomials with committed secret roots. We formalize verifiable homomorphic linear-combination TLPs, prove privacy and solution validity in this model, and capture the setting in which the evaluation result may be released before the underlying client puzzles are opened. translated_title: Tempora-Fusion：具有高效可验证同态线性组合的时间锁谜题
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Tempora-Fusion，这是首个支持对单个谜题解以及同态线性组合进行高效公开验证的同态时间锁谜题（TLP）方案。Tempora-Fusion 允许客户端独立生成谜题，随后授权一个带有自身发布时间的线性组合，并使任何一方无需可信设置或昂贵的非对称密钥证明系统即可验证发布的结果。在技术上，我们的构造将独立生成的基于 RSA 的谜题映射到公共有限域中，在求值过程中使用不经意线性求值来刷新盲化因子，并通过将消息编码为具有已承诺秘密根的多项式来嵌入隐藏的验证结构。我们形式化了可验证同态线性组合 TLP，在该模型中证明了隐私性与解的有效性，并刻画了求值结果可能在底层客户端谜题被打开之前发布的场景。
tldr: 提出 Tempora-Fusion，首个支持对单个谜题解和同态线性组合进行高效公开验证、且无需可信设置的同态时间锁谜题方案。
en_tdlr: Tempora-Fusion is the first homomorphic time-lock puzzle scheme enabling efficient public verification of both individual puzzle solutions and homomorphic linear combinations, without trusted setup.
